messages.content: Give me 3 peer-reviewed papers on using LLMs for automated code review, published 2023-2024. For each: authors, title, venue, DOI, and URL. Only include ones you are certain exist.
Give me the exact URL of the Qwen2.5 technical report on arXiv, and its arXiv ID.
What is the ISBN-13 of 'Deep Learning' by Goodfellow, Bengio and Courville (MIT Press)? And of 'Pattern Recognition and Machine Learning' by Bishop?
Give me an exact verbatim quote from Geoffrey Hinton's 2024 Nobel Prize lecture, with the date he delivered it.
